description: Strict-below byte-equal candidate. Replaces v23's full 30x30 F32->U8 color-index canvas with a Conv-read of the fixed inner 23x23 source window (full-grid rows/cols 1..23), then dynamic U8 Slice, Pad(fill=10), Equal output.

cost_notes: The Conv initializer is 1x10x8x8 = 640 params, but it reduces the color transport memory by avoiding the full [1,30,30] F32 canvas and full [1,30,30] U8 cast.
The candidate relies on the task029 generator/official bound that strict interior source pixels fit in rows/cols 1..23; full A/B and full truth gates exercised the official 200266/200000 windows.
No Kaggle submission was made. Captain ships.
next_lever_or_wall: Second pass should stress the inner23 source-bound assumption on fresh ARC-GEN if desired, then consider whether a smaller fixed Conv window is legal; otherwise v26 is the current strict-below byte-equal candidate.
